title: Continuous Four-Slope Hip Roof Shell
description: One newly authored complete static four-slope hipped roof module. Two long trapezoidal roof planes meet a finite central ridge; two triangular end hips meet the same ridge endpoints and all four outer eave corners. One continuous closed 120mm vertically thick shell has a matching four-plane underside and an entirely unfilled underside opening, not a solid roof-shaped block or a gabled repeat with end walls. Four continuous fascia edges at local Z=0 mounting datum. Clay exterior, darker fascia and timber-toned underside are face materials on the same solid, without overlay planes. Unlike the existing two-slope clay repeat, porch cottage, gabled shop house or L-turn passage, both short ends are pitched roof planes and the ridge terminates inside the rectangle. One modular model, zero scenes. Static appearance only; no host house, canonical dimensional fit, structural support, weatherproofing, roof installation, drainage or building-safety guarantee. Preview floor excluded.
